non_blocking.section: Decision outcome (Restricted profile row); Consequences (sixth Bad bullet)
non_blocking.suggestion: Checking depth over `lexer.Tokenize` output closes the stack-overflow path, but it runs only after the whole token list exists. goccy/go-yaml's token.Token carries several strings, a *Position and Next/Prev pointers, so it costs roughly 150 to 250 bytes (hypothesis). A 64 MiB file of one-byte tokens such as `[[[[` or `[a,a,a` can therefore allocate about 10 GB (hypothesis) before any check runs. The ADR honestly records peak loader memory as unset, so this is not blocking. When the Open question closes, add a token-count limit enforced while tokenizing, or an iterative byte-level depth pre-scan (bracket and indentation stack) that runs before `lexer.Tokenize`.

'a substituted whole-value `${VAR}`' should read 'a substituted whole-value expression', so it plainly covers `${VAR:-default}`, the owning document's own example (`port: ${HTTPS_PORT:-8443}`). Also name the rule for union-typed paths, such as a `oneOf` of integer and string or a Policy `config` chosen by `type`. For example: 'resolved after the discriminator; the first matching type in schema order'. Without that rule, two implementations can disagree on the digest.

'the rest are strings' covers raw values and string fields. It leaves unsaid what a boolean field gets: does `yes` substituted into a boolean field fail RZ-CFG-005, or become true? Add one fixture: substituted text is typed by the YAML 1.2 core schema and then checked against the field type, so `yes` into a boolean field fails RZ-CFG-005.

Carried from the prior round. If goccy/go-yaml's scanner rejects tab-indented JSON, name the fallback: a JSON front end in the same loader that emits the same AST and source map. Otherwise the gate gets disabled, or the 'same loader' promise breaks.

Carried. RFC 8785 serializes numbers as IEEE 754 doubles, so integers above 2^53, such as token Quota limits or byte sizes, can collide in the Revision digest. Ask the Configuration model, through an Open question, to cap schema integers at 2^53-1 or carry such values as strings.

non_blocking.section: Consequences (first Good bullet); Confirmation (Schema generation check)
non_blocking.suggestion: Carried. Kubernetes structural schemas are an OpenAPI v3 subset: no `$ref`, `$defs`, `prefixItems` or `unevaluatedProperties`, and a `type` at every level. The CRD schema is therefore a third lowered artifact. Extend the Planned (M0) generation check to the CRD schemas, or defer that explicitly to ADR-0016 (proposed).

`node scripts/verify-docs.mjs --allow-missing --skip markdownlint` reports no FAIL line for this ADR, so the length band check passes. Its only output is four WARN broken links, to ADR-0016 (lines 21 and 54) and to ADR-0011 and ADR-0017 (line 148). The filenames match the manifest, so the warnings clear once those ADRs exist.
